description: This file defines a base class for a Virtual File System (VFS) used in the Notesnook project, including method stubs for file operations and constants related to SQLite VFS.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: A base class providing stub implementations for file system operations in a custom SQLite Virtual File System (VFS).

methods.name: xClose
methods.description: Closes a file given its fileId, returns SQLITE_IOERR.

methods.name: xRead
methods.description: Reads data from a file at a specified offset, returns SQLITE_IOERR.

methods.name: xWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a file at a specified offset, returns SQLITE_IOERR.

methods.name: xTruncate
methods.description: Truncates a file to a specified size, returns SQLITE_IOERR.

methods.name: xFileSize
methods.description: Gets the size of a file, returns SQLITE_IOERR.

methods.name: xCheckReservedLock
methods.description: Checks for reserved lock, sets result to 0, returns SQLITE_OK.

methods.name: xFileControl
methods.description: Performs file control operations, returns SQLITE_NOTFOUND.

methods.name: handleAsync
methods.description: Handles asynchronous operations; default implementation calls the provided function.
